sourceRefs.locator: Letter 46, pp. 75–76, especially p. 75 from Igitur qui celeber est natalis and p. 76 on the liberated captives. Avitus acknowledges his absence from the ceremony.
pp. 29–31, 47–49 and 55–56. The traditional 496 chronology, the proposed identification of Avitus’s captives and the argument for Christmas 508.

labels.en: Avitus congratulates Clovis on his baptism

note.de: Der Bischof dankt nach der Taufe für die Freilassung von Gefangenen. Das angegebene Zeitfenster lässt auch die Zeit nach Weihnachten 508 zu. Einen Absendeort nennt der erhaltene Text nicht.
note.en: The bishop’s congratulations after the baptism include praise for the release of captives. The time window allows for a letter sent after Christmas 508. The surviving text does not give its place of issue.
